import pathlib,json,re,hashlib,subprocess,shlex,datetime,math
from fractions import Fraction
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/lifeng/Documents/20231788-openfhe-three-track-integration-20260905')
folder=root/'artifacts/handoffs/three-track-integration-01'
source='9c4d83b5cde16e5c5af89886bd73fe5252a99002'
pin='df495ba2e91739a6dc8f1de254fc5a41155ce504'
capture_path=folder/'windows-api-capture.json'
capture=json.loads(capture_path.read_bytes())
raw=capture['raw_log']
lf=raw.replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\r','\n')
log_path=folder/'windows-job-101301287513-lf.log'
assert log_path.read_bytes()==lf.encode('utf-8')
metadata=json.loads((folder/'windows-job-terminal-metadata.json').read_bytes())
assert metadata['id']==101301287513 and metadata['run_id']==33964209898 and metadata['head_sha']==source
assert metadata['status']=='completed' and metadata['conclusion']=='success'
assert metadata['run_attempt']==1
def fp(data):
 return {'utf8_bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
def source_text(path):
 return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',source+':'+path],cwd=root,text=True)
lines=[re.sub(r'^\ufeff?\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s?','',x) for x in lf.splitlines()]
lines=[re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m','',x) for x in lines]
def evidence(pattern):
 return [{'line':i+1,'text':s} for i,s in enumerate(lines) if re.search(pattern,s)]
cmake=source_text('CMakeLists.txt')
bindings=[]
for m in re.finditer(r'add_test\((.*?)\)',cmake,re.S):
 words=m.group(1).split()
 assert words[0]=='NAME' and words[2]=='COMMAND'
 bindings.append({'name':words[1],'command':words[3:],'cmake_line':cmake[:m.start()].count('\n')+1})
assert len(bindings)==60 and len({x['name'] for x in bindings})==60
old=source_text('CMakeLists.txt')
basecmake=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','4ccc8fd2e7617625d27e58a53eb3489e99466ed4:CMakeLists.txt'],cwd=root,text=True)
base=[m.group(1).split() for m in re.finditer(r'add_test\((.*?)\)',basecmake,re.S)]
assert [(['NAME',x['name'],'COMMAND']+x['command']) for x in bindings[:57]]==base
# Only actual execution Start lines establish executions. CTest lists and command echoes do not.
starts=[]
for i,s in enumerate(lines):
 m=re.match(r'\s*Start\s+(\d+):\s+(\S+)\s*$',s)
 if m: starts.append((i,int(m[1]),m[2]))
assert len(starts)==123,len(starts)
expected=[bindings[2]]+bindings[55:57]+bindings[:57]+[bindings[57]]+bindings[58:60]+bindings
assert [s[2] for s in starts]==[b['name'] for b in expected]
actual=[]
for sequence,(i,number,name) in enumerate(starts):
 end=starts[sequence+1][0] if sequence+1<len(starts) else len(lines)
 segment=lines[i:end]
 b=expected[sequence]
 assert bindings[number-1]['name']==name
 commands=[(i+j+1,m[1]) for j,s in enumerate(segment) if (m:=re.match(r'\s*'+str(number)+r': Test command: (.*)$',s))]
 assert len(commands)==1,(sequence,commands)
 command_line,cmd=commands[0]
 args=[a or b for a,b in re.findall(r'"([^\"]*)"|(\S+)',cmd)]
 assert pathlib.PurePosixPath(args[0].replace('\\','/')).name==b['command'][0]+'.exe',(name,args,b)
 assert args[1:]==b['command'][1:]
 passed=[]
 for j,s in enumerate(segment):
  m=re.match(r'\s*(\d+)/(\d+) Test\s+#'+str(number)+r':\s+'+re.escape(name)+r'\s+.*?\bPassed\s+([0-9.]+)\s+sec',s)
  if m: passed.append((i+j+1,s,m))
 assert len(passed)==1,(sequence,name,passed)
 pline,ptext,match=passed[0]
 assert command_line<pline
 actual.append({'execution':sequence+1,'number':number,'name':name,'start_line':i+1,'command_line':command_line,'command':cmd,'pass_line':pline,'pass_text':ptext,'seconds':match[3],'cmake_line':b['cmake_line']})
# Two actual --show-only=json-v1 objects: exact 57 / 60 command args and CMake source line.
live=[]
for i,s in enumerate(lines):
 if s.strip()!='{': continue
 try: obj,_=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode('\n'.join(lines[i:]))
 except json.JSONDecodeError: continue
 if obj.get('kind')!='ctestInfo': continue
 subset=bindings[:57] if len(obj['tests'])==57 else bindings
 assert len(obj['tests']) in (57,60)
 entries=[]
 for t,b in zip(obj['tests'],subset):
  assert t['name']==b['name']
  assert pathlib.PurePosixPath(t['command'][0].replace('\\','/')).name==b['command'][0]+'.exe'
  assert t['command'][1:]==b['command'][1:]
  node=obj['backtraceGraph']['nodes'][t['backtrace']]
  assert node['line']==b['cmake_line'],(t['name'],node,b)
  file=obj['backtraceGraph']['files'][node['file']]
  assert file.replace('\\','/').endswith('/cleanroom/CMakeLists.txt')
  entries.append({'name':t['name'],'command':t['command'],'cmake_line':node['line'],'cmake_path':file})
 live.append({'log_line':i+1,'count':len(entries),'entries':entries})
assert [x['count'] for x in live]==[57,60],[x['count'] for x in live]
stages=[]; cursor=0
for label,count in [('first_mult2_focused',1),('pair_add_sub_focused',2),('legacy57',57),('io_focused',1),('repeated_h128_focused',2),('full60',60)]:
 part=actual[cursor:cursor+count]
 stages.append({'name':label,'count':count,'start_line':part[0]['start_line'],'last_pass_line':part[-1]['pass_line']})
 cursor+=count
required_targets=['relin2_api_contract_test','rs2_api_contract_test','mult2_api_contract_test','add_api_contract_test','sub_api_contract_test','precision_client_io_first_mult2_contract_test','repeated_mult2_semantic_two_square_test','paper_h128_client_keypair_contract_test']
target_evidence={}
for t in required_targets:
 found=evidence(r'Built target '+re.escape(t)+r'$')
 links=evidence(r'Linking CXX executable '+re.escape(t)+r'\.exe')
 assert links,t
 commands=evidence(r'cmake --build .*--target '+re.escape(t)+r' --parallel 2')
 assert commands,t
 target_evidence[t]={'built_target_markers':found,'linked':links,'explicit_commands':commands,'generator_note':'Ninja emits actual Linking CXX executable rather than Make Built target; terminal step success and linking are retained.'}
provenance=evidence(r'PROJECT_SOURCE_COMMIT='+source+r' GITHUB_RUN_ID=33964209898 GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=1')
assert len(provenance)==1
native=evidence(r'(NATIVE_SIZE=64|NATIVEINT: 64|NATIVEINT=64)')
backend=evidence(r'(MATHBACKEND=4|MATHBACKEND: 4|MathBackend: 4)')
assert native and backend
assert evidence(r'NATIVE_SIZE:\s+64') and evidence(r'MATHBACKEND is set to 4')
assert evidence(pin)
project_first=next(i for i,s in enumerate(lines) if 'Building CXX object CMakeFiles/openfhe_2023_1788.dir/' in s)
project_warnings=[{'line':i+1,'text':s} for i,s in enumerate(lines) if i>=project_first and re.search(r'\bwarning:|\bwarning C\d{4}\b',s)]
assert not project_warnings,project_warnings
# Exact decimal strings are parsed as Fraction, never binary floating point.
io_name='precision_client_io_first_mult2_contract'
io80=['max_fresh_public_error','max_fresh_oracle_error','max_product_public_error','max_product_oracle_error','input_public_delta_error','input_oracle_delta_error','product_public_delta_error','product_oracle_delta_error']
io120=['max_horner_component_disagreement','cross_precision_error']
io_records=[]
ordered_markers=[
'first_modulus_boundary_fixture ready=1 actual_first_bits=56 Q_towers=8 N=64 M=128 fixture_new_keypairs=0',
'first_modulus_boundary_rejection passed',
'clone_isolation_contract passed fresh_and_result=1 coefficients=1 scalars=1 present_empty_maps=1',
'shared_params_fixture allocation_plan additional_matching_keypairs=1 additional_eval_keygen_calls=1 actual_first_bits=55 isolated_context_and_bases=1',
'shared_params_fixture ready=1 valid_clone_bind_decrypt=1 actual_first_bits=55 Q_towers=8 fixture_new_keypairs=1 fixture_eval_keygen_calls=1 crypto_complete_before_drift=1',
'shared_params_mutation ready=1 Q_towers_before=8 Q_towers_after=7 immutable_receipt_towers=8 next_boundary=CloneForEvaluation',
'shared_params_boundary_rejection passed boundary=CloneForEvaluation',
'shared_params_boundary_rejection passed boundary=BindFirstMult2Rcb',
'shared_params_boundary_rejection passed boundary=Decrypt',
'shared_params_drift_contract passed boundaries=3 owned_eval_tag_cleanup=1']
for a in actual:
 if a['name']!=io_name: continue
 segment=lines[a['command_line']:a['pass_line']-1]
 metrics=[(a['command_line']+j+1,s) for j,s in enumerate(segment) if 'test='+io_name+' result=PASS source=' in s]
 assert len(metrics)==1
 n,s=metrics[0]; fields=dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=([^\s]+)',s))
 assert fields['source']==source and fields['openfhe_pin']==pin
 assert fields['N']=='64' and fields['S']=='16' and fields['native']=='64' and fields['backend']=='4'
 assert fields['fresh_keypairs']=='1' and fields['eval_keygen_calls']=='1' and fields['malformed_key_rejections']=='32'
 assert fields['q_div']=='1125899906843009' and fields['q_l']=='1125899906840833'
 assert Fraction(int(fields['exact_scale_numerator']),int(fields['exact_scale_denominator']))==Fraction(2**200,1125899906843009*1125899906840833)
 assert int(fields['centered_headroom'])>=0
 for f in io80: assert 0<=Fraction(fields[f])<=Fraction(1,2**80),(f,fields[f])
 for f in io120: assert 0<=Fraction(fields[f])<=Fraction(1,2**120),(f,fields[f])
 marker_lines=[]
 for marker in ordered_markers:
  matches=[a['command_line']+j+1 for j,s in enumerate(segment) if marker in s]
  assert len(matches)==1,(marker,matches)
  marker_lines.append({'marker':marker,'line':matches[0]})
 assert [x['line'] for x in marker_lines]==sorted(x['line'] for x in marker_lines)
 assert n<marker_lines[0]['line']<marker_lines[-1]['line']<a['pass_line']
 io_records.append({'execution':a['execution'],'metrics_line':n,'fields':fields,'fraction_bounds_8_at_2^-80_2_at_2^-120':True,'exact_S1':True,'markers':marker_lines})
assert len(io_records)==2
repeated=[]
for a in actual:
 if a['name']!='repeated_mult2_semantic_two_square_contract': continue
 records=[]
 for i in range(a['command_line'],a['pass_line']-1):
  m=re.match(r'\s*59: (\{.*\})$',lines[i])
  if not m: continue
  o=json.loads(m[1]); assert o['test']==a['name']
  assert o['N']==64 and o['batch']==16 and o['depth']==9 and o['input_scale_bits']==100
  assert o['scope']=='low-N-two-operation-diagnostic' and o['security']=='HEStd_NotSet'
  assert o['secret_distribution']=='UNIFORM_TERNARY'
  d,m1,m2=int(o['d']),int(o['m1']),int(o['m2']); assert len({d,m1,m2})==3
  st=o['stage']; assert st in (1,2) and o['evaluation_family']==st-1 and o['result_family']==1
  assert int(o['m'])==(m1 if st==1 else m2)
  expected_scale=Fraction(2**200,d*m1) if st==1 else Fraction(2**400,d**3*m1**2*m2)
  assert Fraction(int(o['scale_numerator']),int(o['scale_denominator']))==expected_scale
  assert math.gcd(int(o['scale_numerator']),int(o['scale_denominator']))==1
  for f in ['max_slot_error','delta_error']: assert 0<=Fraction(o[f])<=Fraction(1,2**80)
  assert o['observed_product_headroom_bits']>=1
  records.append({'line':i+1,'record':o})
 assert [(x['record']['trial'],x['record']['stage']) for x in records]==[(trial,stage) for trial in range(4) for stage in (1,2)]
 assert len({x['record']['tag'] for x in records})==4
 repeated.append({'execution':a['execution'],'records':records,'actual_records':8,'slots_checked_per_record':16,'exact_reduced_stage_scales_and_error_bounds':True,'assertion_evidence_note':'PASS after Evaluate validates stage-two wiring, unchanged re-entry coefficient values, immutable parent-derived exact receipts, input/context/key immutability, 10 rejection calls, and owned-row cleanup at source lines 191-310; assertions are not separately logged.'})
assert len(repeated)==2
h128=[]
markers=['valid-path assertions passed (diagnostic, not paper evidence)','50 named rejection assertions passed (no injected tag collisions)','two-call uniqueness and owned-tag cache-isolation assertions passed']
for a in actual:
 if a['name']!='paper_h128_client_keypair_contract': continue
 output=[]
 for marker in markers:
  found=[{'line':i+1,'text':lines[i]} for i in range(a['command_line'],a['pass_line']-1) if marker in lines[i]]
  assert len(found)==1
  output.extend(found)
 assert [x['line'] for x in output]==sorted(x['line'] for x in output)
 h128.append({'execution':a['execution'],'markers':output,'source_assertion_evidence':{'test_path':'tests/paper_h128_client_keypair_contract_test.cpp','native64_backend4_guard_line':19,'actual_coefficient_weight128_sign_balance_and_common_Q_support_lines':[218,236],'primitive_roundtrip_encrypt_relin_square_decrypt_lines':[271,290],'full_packed_slots':128,'N':256,'primitive_absolute_tolerance':'1e-5','negative_guards':50,'not_claimed':'No h128 per-coefficient values are printed; marker plus exact source and process PASS proves execution of these fail-fast assertions, not paper-scale precision/security.'}})
assert len(h128)==2
tests_evidence=[]
for path in ['tests/precision_client_io_first_mult2_contract_test.cpp','tests/repeated_mult2_semantic_two_square_test.cpp','tests/paper_h128_client_keypair_contract_test.cpp']:
 b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',source+':'+path],cwd=root)
